attributes.name: Mammy Graul
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, each character at this location summons and encounters an Ancient Skeleton henchman.

The first time in this scenario that anyone would defeat Mammy Graul, she is undefeated.

"Is that you, butter knuckles? Climb on over your brothers and give Mammy a squeeze!"—Mammy Graul
